nodes.description: Contract owner address declared in BotProtected/ChowInu; assigned from tx.origin in the ChowInu constructor and used for privileged access checks.
Address of the Ferrum bot-protection contract set in the constructor; target of several low-level external calls.
Public address of the Uniswap/Pancake style pair derived from wBNB and this token; passed into the bot-protection call.
Public mapping of token balances written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, distribute and list.
Public nested mapping of approvals written in approve and the constructor, decremented with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Fixed total supply (1e30) initialised at declaration and used in list to size the owner balance.
IUniswapV2Router02 instance at 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D used to add liquidity.
Wrapped BNB mainnet address used to compute the pair address in the constructor.
BotProtected constructor that stores the supplied bot-protection contract address into stopTheBots.
Modifier performing a low-level call to stopTheBots with selector 0x15274141 and requiring success before the guarded body executes.
ChowInu constructor: sets owner to tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and the pair.
Public payable transfer that forwards all work to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Guarded by checkBots; decrements allowance and updates balances with unchecked arithmetic before emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure helper computing the CREATE2 pair address from the sorted token pair.
Owner-only function calling stopTheBots and then overwriting the balances of an arbitrary address list inside a loop.
Owner-only function that sets balances, calls addLiquidityETH with a block.timestamp deadline, then overwrites balances in a loop.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance checks, approvals and owner comparisons.
Transaction origin used as the contract owner and as an unlimited allowance holder in the constructor.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the swap deadline block.timestamp + 600.
Low-level stopTheBots.call(0x15274141, _from, _to, uniPair, _value) inside the checkBots modifier; external call executed before state updates.
a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary calldata in the context of this contract's storage.
pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) external call with user-supplied amounts and deadline.
stopTheBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3, _toAddresses) external call inside distribute.
stopTheBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3, _toAddresses) external call inside list.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value under Solidity 0.7 with no SafeMath.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value allowing underflow.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, also passed to the bot-protection call.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate used as the delegatecall destination.
Arbitrary calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
First token address parameter of pairOf.
Second token address parameter of pairOf.
Recipient array parameter of distribute, also forwarded to the bot-protection call.
Balance amount parameter of distribute.
Token amount parameter of list used as liquidity amount and contract balance.
Recipient array parameter of list, also forwarded to the bot-protection call.
Amounts array parameter of list used to overwrite balances.
Bot-protection address parameter of the ChowInu constructor.
Bot-protection address parameter of the BotProtected constructor.
From address parameter of the checkBots modifier forwarded to the external call.
To address parameter of the checkBots modifier forwarded to the external call.
Value parameter of the checkBots modifier forwarded to the external call.
Boolean returned by the stopTheBots call and required to gate the checkBots modifier body.
Raw bytes returndata captured from the stopTheBots call in checkBots.
Lower-ordered token address computed in pairOf.
Higher-ordered token address computed in pairOf.
Loop index used to iterate over _toAddresses in distribute.
Loop index used to iterate over _toAddresses in list.
Boolean success flag returned from the delegatecall in delegate.
Computed pair address returned by pairOf.

msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether an allowance check is required.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.

distribute is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
list is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
The constructor sets owner from tx.origin, enabling tx.origin based privilege.
tx.origin is written directly into the owner state variable and given an unlimited allowance.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in list.
A timestamp-derived deadline is passed into the external router call.
owner is compared with msg.sender to guard delegate.
owner is compared with msg.sender to guard distribute.
owner is compared with msg.sender to guard list.
stopTheBots is the target of the low-level call in the checkBots modifier.
stopTheBots is the target of the low-level call in distribute.
stopTheBots is the target of the low-level call in list.
uniPair is passed into the external bot-protection call from the modifier.
balanceOf[_from] is read before the debit in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and addition.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and compared against _value.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping without SafeMath.
approve writes into the allowance mapping.
allowance[msg.sender][_spender] is assigned _value in approve.
The constructor writes unlimited allowances for the router and the pair.
The constructor reads/initialises allowance entries for this contract and tx.origin.
totalSupply is used to compute balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100.
pancakeRouter is the external contract invoked by addLiquidityETH.
uniPair is assigned the result of pairOf in the constructor.
The ChowInu constructor invokes pairOf(wBNB, address(this)).
The address returned by pairOf is stored into uniPair.
BotProtected constructor writes the bot-protection address into stopTheBots.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
The checkBots modifier wraps the transferFrom body, performing an external call before state changes.
The modifier performs a low-level external call to stopTheBots before the guarded logic runs.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
Balances are mutated through unchecked arithmetic on the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom performs an unchecked allowance subtraction.
The allowance mapping is decremented without SafeMath protection.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the caller.

The router call happens after balance writes, allowing state to be observed/re-entered mid-function.
distribute overwrites balanceOf entries for every address in the loop.
list overwrites balanceOf entries for every address in the second loop.
